text: DSH Skills Management 汇总 DSH Registry、文件系统和 Agent 作用域中的技能，提供搜索、来源与调用状态筛选，并分别控制文件型技能的模型自动调用和用户 /name 手动调用。 页面还汇总各作用域的注册技能，提供名称或描述搜索，并展示文件来源和当前调用状态。便于快速了解。

DSH Skills Management aggregates skills from DSH registries and file scopes, with search and source or invocation filters. It independently controls model invocation and user /name invocation for file-backed skills. It shows skills across scopes with source and invocation state.
我想统一查看 DSH 里注册的技能，并按来源或调用状态筛选。
能不能只关闭某个技能的模型自动调用，同时保留我手动输入斜杠命令调用它？
我想在一个侧边栏页面管理文件型技能的开关。
技能正文或 frontmatter 更新后，如何让管理页面读取当前文件内容？
非文件 Provider 的技能也显示在目录里吗？
技能文件已经消失了，怎么清掉遗留的调用策略而不删除源文件？
DSH Skills Management 聚合 Registry、文件系统和 Agent 作用域的技能清单，并将同名项目合并展示。
DSH Skills Management 分别设置文件型技能的模型调用与用户手动调用状态；非文件 Provider 条目保持只读。
DSH Skills Management 在清单刷新时读取文件型技能 frontmatter，并在每次调用时读取当前正文。
DSH Skills Management 提供侧边栏管理面板，可搜索技能，并按来源和调用状态过滤列表。
DSH Skills Management 对已经缺失的技能提供删除策略记录的操作，策略恢复时会保留原始技能文件。

dsh-skills-management README · DSH Skills Management：English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Skill catalog and invocation-policy plugin. Skills from every Provider remain visible, while file-backed Skills support independent model and user manual invocation controls. The plugin reads current source files without modifying `SKILL.md`, frontmatter, references, scripts, Junctions, or Git workspaces.

Repository: <https://github.com/JayC-L/dsh-skills-management>

dsh-skills-management README · Features：- **Two channels for file-backed Skills**: control model invocation and user manual invocation (`/name`) independently.
- **Live source reads**: refresh frontmatter when the catalog is recomputed and read the current body on every invocation.
- **Original resource locations**: references, scripts, and other resources remain in the source Skill directory instead of being copied into policy data.
- **Complete catalog**: in-memory, remote, and dynamic Providers remain visible but read-only; the Host rejects policy changes for them as well.
- **Missing-policy cleanup**: when a file-backed Skill disappears, its row shows a native delete button that removes only the policy record.
- **Native DSH UI**: shared Button, Input, Tag, Switch, icons, and semantic design tokens.
- **One global view**: aggregates the DSH Registry, filesystem, and Agent scopes without per-session policy controls.

dsh-skills-management README · Requirements：- DSH `>=0.2.1-rc.5 <0.3.0-0`.
- Verified with DSH `0.2.2-rc.1`, Cordis `4.1.0`, and the Desktop Profile.
- The browser client uses the DSH ModuleLoader and native UI primitives; it does not bundle React.

dsh-skills-management README · Plugin package：Add this repository in the DSH plugin manager, or use the prebuilt Release package:

```text
https://github.com/JayC-L/dsh-skills-management/releases/latest/download/dsh-skills-management.tgz
```

On DSH Desktop, use the application's built-in plugin manager. After installation and activation, refresh the page and open **Skills Management** in the sidebar.

dsh-skills-management README · From source：```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run check
pnpm test
pnpm pack

dsh-skills-management README · Which Skills can be managed：A manageable Skill must meet all of these conditions:

1. It is registered with the current DSH Registry.
2. It comes from a project, user, or explicitly configured custom file directory.
3. It has a verifiable local file path.
4. Its frontmatter is valid and its declared name matches the Skill name.

Regular directories, flat Markdown files, and Junctions are supported. A file discovered on disk but not registered with DSH is not treated as a manageable invocation target.

dsh-skills-management README · Which Skills can be managed：Non-file Providers continue to supply their own catalog entries and content. This plugin does not take over, copy, or persist their bodies, and it does not infer a local path from a `source` label. These rows show **Read only**, and direct management API requests are rejected too. Bundled Provider assets are read-only even when a `SKILL.md` file exists.
dsh-skills-management README · Invocation channels：User manual invocation means that a user explicitly selects a Skill with `/name`. It is independent of automatic selection by the model.

dsh-skills-management README · Invocation channels：| Model | User manual | Status | Behavior |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| On | On | Available | Both model and user manual invocation are available |
| Off | On | User manual only | The model cannot invoke it, but `/name` remains available |
| On | Off | Model only | The model can invoke it, but user manual invocation is disabled |
| Off | Off | Disabled | Neither channel can invoke it |

dsh-skills-management README · Invocation channels：Policy is global by Skill name, so same-name Skills are managed together. Restoring the original invocation defaults removes the policy record; those defaults are not necessarily both channels enabled.

dsh-skills-management README · Invocation channels：Before saving a single-channel policy, the Host reads the current original definitions and compares their content, resources, and original invocation flags across scopes. Conflicting same-name definitions are rejected instead of risking the wrong content. You can explicitly disable both channels without reading or sharing same-name bodies.

dsh-skills-management README · Catalog and refresh：Refresh rereads policy, scans explicitly configured Skill directories, and aggregates the Registry and scopes. File-backed metadata is read when the Registry recomputes its catalog. Every `get()` reads the current body, so body updates do not require toggling a policy.

Search by name or description and combine invocation-status and source filters. Built-in groups start collapsed and expand automatically for searches and filters.

dsh-skills-management README · Missing entries and deletion：A Skill is marked missing only when a complete catalog or verifiable file evidence confirms that its original definition is gone. Scope failures, incomplete Registries, and indeterminate states return an error instead of being misreported as missing.

Missing rows replace the two switches with a native **Delete** button:

dsh-skills-management README · Policy file：Default location:

```text
~/.dsh/skills-management/disabled.json
```

Each record contains only invocation policy and file-location metadata:

dsh-skills-management README · Policy file：| Field | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `modelInvocable` | Effective model invocation state |
| `userInvocable` | Effective user manual invocation state |
| `originalInvocation` | Original defaults captured for correct restoration |
| `display` | Original description, Provider, source, and optional usage guidance |
| `liveFile` | File-backed policy marker, currently `true` |
| `sourcePath` | Current source file location |
| `sourceBase` | Resource-resolution directory |

dsh-skills-management README · Policy file：Policy never stores Skill bodies or the contents of references and scripts. `sourcePath` and `sourceBase` are internal to the Host and are not returned by the management list API.

Writes use a serial queue, a strict disk reread before mutation, a temporary file in the same directory, `fsync`, and atomic replacement. A damaged policy may temporarily fall back to the last valid in-memory state for reads, but all writes are rejected so stale memory cannot overwrite the damaged file.

dsh-skills-management README · Implementation and safety boundaries：- A low-rank policy Provider overrides invocation flags and live file definitions only for file-backed Skills. Removing policy restores the original Provider automatically.
- File-backed catalog reads use current frontmatter; invocation reads use the current body and validate its declared Skill name.
- Missing files, identity conflicts, duplicate candidates, and I/O errors are never silently replaced with other content.
- Saving a policy that needs a body temporarily removes the old overlay to read the original Provider. Capture or final-write failures roll back the old policy, but the original definition can be briefly exposed during capture.
- Management endpoints accept loopback requests only and validate the Host, Origin, method, and mutation headers.
- The plugin does not modify Skill source files, scan unrelated application directories, collect telemetry, or initiate external network requests.

dsh-skills-management README · Implementation and safety boundaries：Management endpoints:

```text
GET  /api/dsh-skills-management/list
POST /api/dsh-skills-management/set
```

`/set` supports `model`, `user`, and `both` channel changes, plus `action: "remove"` after a fresh missing-state check.

dsh-skills-management README · Uninstall：Uninstalling disposes global and Agent-scoped policy Providers, page Slots, and management endpoints, restoring original Providers. The policy file is retained so the same file-backed policies can be applied after reinstallation. To remove it completely, restore each Skill's defaults or delete its missing policy before uninstalling.

dsh-skills-management README · Tests：```sh
pnpm run check
pnpm test
```

Coverage includes independent channels, original defaults, same-name conflicts, live body and metadata reads, resource paths, flat files, Junctions, missing recovery and deletion, read-only non-file Providers, atomic writes, damaged-policy protection, the real DSH Registry, Agent scopes, and plugin teardown.

dsh-skills-management README · DSH 技能管理：[English](README.md) | 简体中文

一个用于查看 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Skill 清单并管理调用策略的插件。所有 Provider 的 Skill 都可展示；文件型 Skill 支持独立的模型调用和用户手动调用控制。插件读取当前源文件，不修改 `SKILL.md`、frontmatter、references、scripts、Junction 或 Git 工作区。

仓库：<https://github.com/JayC-L/dsh-skills-management>

dsh-skills-management README · 功能：- **文件型双通道管理**：分别控制模型调用和用户手动调用（`/名称`）。
- **实时源文件**：清单重新计算时读取当前 frontmatter，每次实际调用时读取当前正文。
- **保留资源位置**：references、scripts 等资源继续从原 Skill 目录解析，不复制、不打包进策略。
- **完整清单**：内存、远程和动态 Provider 也可展示，但不提供策略开关，Host 同样拒绝修改。
- **未加载策略清理**：文件型原 Skill 消失后显示“未加载”和原生删除按钮，只删除策略记录。
- **原生 DSH UI**：使用共享 Button、Input、Tag、Switch、图标和语义设计令牌。
- **全局统一视图**：汇总 DSH Registry、文件系统与各 Agent 作用域，不提供按会话分别设置。

dsh-skills-management README · 运行要求：- DSH `>=0.2.1-rc.5 <0.3.0-0`。
- 已在 DSH `0.2.2-rc.1`、Cordis `4.1.0` 和 Desktop Profile 上验证。
- 浏览器客户端使用 DSH ModuleLoader 与原生 UI primitives，不单独打包 React。

dsh-skills-management README · 插件包：在 DSH 插件管理页面添加本仓库，或下载 Release 中的预构建包：

```text
https://github.com/JayC-L/dsh-skills-management/releases/latest/download/dsh-skills-management.tgz
```

DSH Desktop 请使用应用内的插件管理功能。安装并启用后，刷新页面，在左侧打开 **技能管理**。

dsh-skills-management README · 从源码开发：```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run check
pnpm test
pnpm pack

dsh-skills-management README · 哪些 Skill 可以管理：可管理项必须同时满足：

1. 已接入当前 DSH Registry；
2. 来源属于项目、用户或显式配置的自定义文件目录；
3. 具有可验证的本地文件路径；
4. 文件内容与 Skill 名称匹配，frontmatter 有效。

普通目录、平铺 Markdown 和 Junction 都支持。仅扫描到文件、但没有注册进 DSH 的条目不会被当作可调用 Skill 管理。

非文件型 Provider 继续由原 Provider 提供清单和正文。本插件不会接管、复制或保存它们的正文，也不会根据 `source` 标签猜测本地路径。页面显示“仅显示”，直接调用管理 API 同样会被拒绝。系统内置 Provider 的资源文件仅供展示，即使存在 `SKILL.md` 也不提供开关。

text:
dsh-skills-management README · 双通道行为：用户手动调用是指在输入框中通过 `/名称` 主动调用 Skill；它与模型自动选择 Skill 是两条独立通道。

| 模型调用 | 用户手动调用 | 页面状态 | 效果 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 开 | 开 | 可调用 | 模型和用户手动调用均可用 |
| 关 | 开 | 仅用户 | 模型不可调用，用户手动调用仍可用 |
| 开 | 关 | 仅模型 | 模型可调用，用户手动调用已关闭 |
| 关 | 关 | 已禁用 | 两种方式均不可用 |

策略按 Skill 名称全局生效，同名 Skill 会一起管理。恢复到原始默认调用状态后，对应策略记录自动删除；原始默认状态不一定两个通道都开启。

修改单通道策略时，Host 会读取当前原定义并检查不同作用域中的正文、资源和原始调用状态。发现同名定义不一致时会拒绝保存，避免执行错误内容；可显式同时关闭两个通道，不读取或共享同名正文。

dsh-skills-management README · 清单与刷新：每行显示：

- Skill 名称与当前描述；
- Provider 名称；
- 来源形态：本地文件、Junction、来源文件、路径失效、仅注册、内置资源、非文件或未加载；
- 当前调用状态；
- 文件型双开关、非文件型“仅显示”，或未加载删除按钮。

以下操作会重新请求管理清单：

- 页面组件挂载；
- 开关或删除操作成功；
- 点击右上角“刷新”。

刷新会重新读取策略、扫描明确配置的 Skill 目录并汇总 Registry 与各作用域。文件型 Provider 在 Registry 重新计算清单时读取当前描述；每次 `get()` 都重新读取当前正文，因此正文更新不依赖重新切换开关。

支持按名称或描述搜索，并按调用状态和来源组合筛选。系统内置分组默认折叠，搜索或筛选时会自动展开。

dsh-skills-management README · 未加载与删除：只有完整清单或可验证文件证据确认原 Skill 已消失时，才标记“当前未加载”。作用域采集失败、Registry 不完整或暂时无法判断时会返回错误，不会把失败误报为缺失。

未加载行不显示双开关，而显示原生“删除”按钮：

- 删除前重新扫描并确认仍未加载；
- 只删除对应的策略记录；
- 不删除 Skill 源文件或 Junction；
- 若原 Skill 已恢复，则返回 409，不删除策略；
- 其他策略保持不变。

打开页面和普通刷新不会自动删除策略。

dsh-skills-management README · 策略文件：默认位置：

```text
~/.dsh/skills-management/disabled.json
```

每条记录只保存调用策略和文件定位信息：

| 字段 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `modelInvocable` | 策略生效后的模型调用状态 |
| `userInvocable` | 策略生效后的用户手动调用状态 |
| `originalInvocation` | 首次设置时的原始默认状态，用于正确恢复 |
| `display` | 原始描述、Provider、来源和可选适用场景 |
| `liveFile` | 文件型策略标记，当前为 `true` |
| `sourcePath` | 当前源文件位置 |
| `sourceBase` | 资源解析目录 |

策略中不保存 Skill 正文，也不保存 references 或 scripts 的内容。`sourcePath`、`sourceBase` 仅供 Host 使用，管理列表 API 不返回这些路径。
dsh-skills-management README · 策略文件：写入使用串行队列、写入前严格重读、同目录临时文件、`fsync` 和原子替换。运行中遇到损坏策略时可暂时沿用最后一次有效状态，但任何写入都会被拒绝，避免用旧内存覆盖损坏文件。

dsh-skills-management README · 实现与安全边界：- 注册低 rank 策略 Provider，只覆盖文件型 Skill 的调用标志和实时文件定义；删除策略后，原 Provider 自动恢复。
- 文件型清单读取当前 frontmatter，实际调用读取当前正文，并校验 frontmatter 中的名称。
- 文件缺失、身份冲突、重复候选或 I/O 错误不会被静默替换为其他内容。
- 设置需要正文的策略时会临时移除旧覆盖以读取原 Provider；抓取或最终写入失败会回滚旧策略，但抓取期间存在短暂的原始定义暴露窗口。
- 管理接口仅接受本机回环请求，并校验 Host、Origin、请求方法和修改请求头。
- 插件不修改 Skill 源文件，不扫描无关应用目录，不收集遥测，也不主动发起外部网络请求。

管理接口：

```text
GET  /api/dsh-skills-management/list
POST /api/dsh-skills-management/set
```

`/set` 支持 `model`、`user`、`both` 通道修改，以及经过再次缺失确认的 `action: "remove"` 策略删除。
dsh-skills-management README · 卸载：卸载插件会注销全局和 Agent 作用域中的策略 Provider、页面 Slot 与管理接口，原 Provider 随即恢复。策略文件默认保留，重新安装后可继续应用相同文件型策略；如需彻底清除，请在卸载前恢复各项默认状态或删除对应未加载策略。

dsh-skills-management README · 测试：```sh
pnpm run check
pnpm test
```

测试覆盖双通道、原始默认状态、同名冲突、实时正文与描述、资源路径、平铺文件、Junction、缺失恢复与删除、非文件型只读、原子写入、损坏策略保护、真实 DSH Registry、Agent 作用域和插件卸载。
dsh-skills-management README · 许可证：[MIT](LICENSE)
